title: 第13章  就他了！
slug: 穿成星际废雌捡漏sss级兽夫赢麻了
content_zh:
侧殿里，姜知夏坐在主位上打了个哈欠。
眼前站着一溜男人，贵族基因摆在那儿，他们的身材外貌算不上顶尖也绝不差。
问题是，他们的背景资料都在自己手里，一眼看过去，没一个正常的。
“公主！我是豹族，等级S级，半年前退役……”
等级不错，军部新星，不过精神力破损了。
“公主！我是蛇族，等级A级，就职帝国财政……”
这个有钱，不过私底下有半兽化施虐的癖好。
“公主殿下，我是……”
姜知夏嘴角抽搐着挥手：“下一批！”
她倒是开始庆幸了，幸亏答应了苏尘，不然就这些要么残缺要么有特殊癖好的男人做她的未婚夫，难免会多出一些不必要的麻烦。
一屋子的雄性退出去，新一批鱼贯而入。
又拒绝了好几轮，苏尘才垂着眼走进来。
他今天穿了一身深蓝色礼服，衬得肤色越发白皙。
到这一步，他难免也会紧张，不知道公主会不会遵守那个荒谬的承诺……
如果公主反悔，或者根本就是在戏弄他……他半点退路都没了。
他抬眼看向主位上的姜知夏，躬身行礼：“公主殿下。”
姜知夏眼前一亮。
终于来了！
这一批加上苏尘总共六人，其他五个都是出身显赫的贵族子弟。
“公主，我的精神力是S级，目前在……”

“公主殿下，我是狮族……”
轮到苏尘的时候，其他几人同时侧目，抱着看好戏的心态。
他们在想：苏尘要怎么说自己的出身？
苏家嫡系？他父亲早就死了，现在苏家的正夫位置是别人坐着，他一个前任正夫的儿子，连嫡系都算不上。
一个精神力A级的雄性，唯一拿得出手的身份就是治疗师。
可哪个雌性需要一个治疗师做正夫呢？
又不能赚钱，又没有强大的实力。
苏尘沉默了几秒，缓缓开口：“公主，我是苏家——”
“不用说了！就你了！”
全场静了一瞬。
苏尘滚在喉间的一句“私生子”被堵了回去，愣住了。
他看着姜知夏，心情微妙。
她真的选了他？
因为那个微不足道的耳光？
其他人也愣住了，惊愕地看了看公主，又看了看苏尘。
姜知夏已经急不可耐的对侍卫挥手，“好了，别人都出去吧，就他了！”
看了一圈下来，她早就不耐烦了。
对比这些明显被塞进来敷衍她的男人们，还是苏尘好。
因为只有他还算正常的！
“公主！”一个雄性忍不住上前一步，“您要不要再考虑一下？他——”

姜知夏皱起眉，“我选谁还要你来评判吗？”
那人被噎住，脸色青白交加，“……不敢。”
五个雄性陆续退出殿外，每个人离开前都忍不住回头看一眼苏尘。
凭什么是他？！
人就是这么复杂。
进来之前，他们还担心被公主看上，和一个C级废雌缔结契约。
可眨眼间输给一个处处不如自己的雄性，他们又不甘心了。
等殿门关上，姜知夏这才松了口气。
她从主位上走下来，笑着对苏尘说：“答应你的我可做到了啊。”
苏尘怔怔的看着她，眼眸倒映着她的笑容，那股轻浅的香气又飘了过来。
心脏漏了一拍。
还不到他胸口的雌性仰着头，目光清澈干净的看着他。
“还需要我做什么吗？”
苏尘沉默了许久，再次单膝跪地。
这一次明显比上次郑重了许多，他牵起公主的手，在她的手背上落下一个轻柔的吻。
“已经足够了，多谢公主。”
姜霆走向侧殿，刚好落选的雄性们乌泱泱退出来。
他们杂七杂八的讨论着。
“公主什么情况？真选苏尘了？”
“那个废物，还只是个治疗师，皇室会接受他做公主正夫？”

“要是公主实在喜欢，那还真不一定……你们说公主是不是就喜欢这款的？柔柔弱弱这样的……”
“嗤，不过说真的，苏尘那张脸确实……”
议论声戛然而止。
他们看着迎面走来的姜霆，连忙行礼：“大殿下。”
姜霆冷着脸，看都没看他们，大步向侧殿走去。
姜知夏和苏尘一起走出来，两人靠得不远不近。
“……总之，虽然我不知道你为什么想让我选你，不过只要你想解除这层关系，随时告诉我。”
苏尘的指尖略微蜷缩了一下，无奈地小声回应：“公主答应我，这件事一定要保密。”
“我懂我懂！”姜知夏连连点头。
这事当然不能告诉任何人！
但她还有点担心：在这种雌尊雄卑的背景下，就算以后撇清关系，有了“公主前未婚夫”这层标签，苏尘将来再找雌主，难保不会被刁难。
她不觉得苏尘是为了皇室身份，不然他也不会承诺三个月后主动解除婚约。
两人一抬头，看见了不远处身高腿长的人影。
姜知夏应激一样立正站好：“大、大哥！”
姜霆走近，目光先落在她脸上，然后缓缓滑向旁边的苏尘。
“你选他？”
姜知夏僵硬点头：“嗯……苏尘哥哥挺好的。”
姜霆的眼底深了深。
苏尘哥哥？
这就叫上哥哥了？

他看向苏尘，SS级的压迫感无声蔓开，空气都仿佛凝滞了几分。
苏尘察觉到这位大殿下的敌意，顶着压力微微躬身：“大殿下。”
然后，他做了一个让姜霆咬紧牙关的动作。
他轻轻牵起姜知夏的手，十指相扣，抬头对姜霆温和一笑。
“承蒙公主厚爱，我也对公主有爱慕之心，还希望大殿下能对我满意。”
姜知夏也没挣扎，牵个手而已，演戏要演全套。
姜霆的视线在两人交握的手上停留了几秒。
姜知夏不敢吱声，苏尘也不清楚这位大殿下的意思。
“随你。”
姜霆丢下两个字，迈开长腿走了，背影都透着股生人勿近的寒意。
姜知夏丈二和尚摸不着头脑，“大哥……怎么了？”
好像生气了？
消息传得比光速还快。
当天，“三公主选定正夫”的新闻就冲上了帝国热搜。
皇室官方账号公布了人选，配图是苏尘的单人影像。
评论区纷纷不甘心：
【苏尘？那个治疗师？公主选他？！】
【我要是没记错，他是A级鹿族吧？啊啊啊早知道我也报名了！】
【楼上的别痴心妄想，人家好歹是一等贵族，换你连竞选都没资格，像白知遇一样哈哈哈】
【等等，你们不觉得公主可能就喜欢温柔挂的吗？以前是白知遇，现在是苏尘，好像都是一个类型哎】

【哇……替身文学吗？】
曾雯雯在房间里来回踱步，不敢置信地盯着光脑。
“不可能……这怎么可能？！”
姜知夏选了别人做正夫？
她真的不喜欢白知遇了？！
生日宴的段视频她看了，可因为姜知夏以前的舔狗行为太深入人心，她一直认为那是欲擒故纵的把戏！
那天姜知夏和自己说什么绝交，她还在生气，这几天都憋在家里，等着姜知夏上门道歉。
反正那个蠢货身边一个朋友都没有，一定会像以前一样，过不了几天就慌慌张张地跑来讨好她。
可是等来等去，一切都变了！
曾雯雯烦躁地关了光脑，在房间里又转了两圈。
她得去看看姜知夏到底在发什么疯！
content_en:
In the side hall, Jiang Zhixia sat on the main seat and yawned.
Standing in front of them were a group of men with aristocratic genes. Their figures and appearance were neither top-notch nor bad.
The problem is, they all have their background information in their hands, and at a glance, none of them are normal.
"Princess! I am from the Leopard Clan, S level. I retired half a year ago..."
He has a good level and is a new star in the military, but his mental strength is damaged.
"Princess! I am from the Snake Clan, Level A, and I am employed as the Imperial Finance..."
This guy is rich, but secretly he has a habit of becoming a half-animal and sadistic person.
"Your Highness Princess, I am..."
Jiang Zhixia's mouth twitched and waved: "Next batch!"
She was beginning to feel lucky that she agreed to Su Chen, otherwise it would inevitably cause unnecessary trouble for these men who were either handicapped or had special quirks to be her fiancé.
A room full of males exited, and a new batch filed in.
After several more rounds of rejection, Su Chen walked in with lowered eyes.
He wore a dark blue dress today, which made his complexion even whiter.
At this point, he will inevitably be nervous, not knowing whether the princess will keep that ridiculous promise...
If the princess went back on her word, or was simply teasing him...he would have no way out.
He raised his eyes to look at Jiang Zhixia who was sitting on the throne, bowed and saluted: "Your Highness the Princess."
Jiang Zhixia's eyes lit up.
It’s finally here!
There are six people in this group including Su Chen, and the other five are all aristocratic children with prominent backgrounds.
"Princess, my mental power is S level, currently..."
"Your Highness Princess, I am from the Lion Clan..."
When it was Su Chen's turn, several other people looked sideways at the same time, with the mentality of watching a good show.
They were thinking: What would Su Chen say about his origins?
Direct descendant of the Su family? His father died a long time ago, and now the position of the head husband of the Su family is occupied by someone else. He is the son of the previous head husband, and he is not even a direct descendant.
A male with an A-level mental power, the only identity he can use is that of a therapist.
But what female needs a therapist as a real husband?
It can't make money, and it doesn't have strong strength.
Su Chen was silent for a few seconds and then slowly said: "Princess, I am from the Su family——"
"No need to say anything! It's just you!"
The whole place was silent for a moment.
Su Chen choked back the words "illegitimate son" that rolled in his throat and was stunned.
He looked at Jiang Zhixia with a subtle mood.
Did she really choose him?
Because of that insignificant slap?
The others were also stunned, looking at the princess and then at Su Chen in shock.
Jiang Zhixia waved to the guards impatiently, "Okay, everyone else can go out, it's just him!"
After looking around, she was already impatient.
Compared with these men who were obviously brought in to deal with her, Su Chen was better.
Because he is the only one who is still normal!
"Princess!" A male couldn't help but step forward, "Do you want to think about it again? He -"
Jiang Zhixia frowned, "Do I need you to judge who I choose?"
The man was choked, his face turned green and white, "...don't dare."
The five males exited the hall one after another, and everyone couldn't help but look back at Su Chen before leaving.
Why him? !
People are so complicated.
Before coming in, they were worried about being attracted by the princess and entering into a contract with a C-level useless female.
But they were unwilling to lose to a male who was inferior to them in every aspect in the blink of an eye.
When the palace door closed, Jiang Zhixia breathed a sigh of relief.
She walked down from the main seat and said to Su Chen with a smile, "I did what I promised you."
Su Chen looked at her blankly, his eyes reflecting her smile, and the light fragrance floated over again.
My heart skipped a beat.
The female, who was not even close to his chest, raised her head and looked at him with clear and clean eyes.
"Do you need me to do anything else?"
Su Chen was silent for a long time and knelt down on one knee again.
This time he was obviously much more solemn than last time. He took the princess's hand and saidPlace a soft kiss on the back of her hand.
"That's enough, thank you princess."
Jiang Ting walked towards the side hall, and the males who happened to be defeated came out in a hurry.
They were discussing miscellaneously.
"What's going on with the princess? Did you really choose Su Chen?"
"That loser is just a therapist. Will the royal family accept him as the princess's husband?"
"If the princess really likes it, then it's not necessarily true... Do you think the princess likes this one? So soft and weak..."
"Tsk, but to be honest, Su Chen's face is indeed..."
The discussion stopped abruptly.
They looked at Jiang Ting walking towards them and saluted quickly: "Your Highness."
Jiang Ting had a cold face and strode towards the side hall without even looking at them.
Jiang Zhixia and Su Chen walked out together, not too far or too close to each other.
"...Anyway, although I don't know why you want me to choose you, if you want to end this relationship, please tell me at any time."
Su Chen curled up his fingertips slightly and responded helplessly in a low voice: "Princess, promise me that this matter must be kept secret."
"I understand, I understand!" Jiang Zhixia nodded repeatedly.
Of course you can’t tell anyone about this!
But she was still a little worried: in this context of female supremacy, even if they ended the relationship in the future, with the label of "Princess's ex-fiancé", Su Chen would not be able to make things difficult for him if he found a female protagonist in the future.
She didn't think Su Chen was doing it for his royal status, otherwise he wouldn't have promised to terminate the engagement after three months.
The two looked up and saw a tall figure with long legs not far away.
Jiang Zhixia stood at attention as if he was stressed: "Big, big brother!"
Jiang Ting walked closer, his eyes first falling on her face, and then slowly sliding towards Su Chen beside her.
"You choose him?"
Jiang Zhixia nodded stiffly: "Well... Brother Su Chen is pretty good."
Jiang Ting's eyes darkened.
Brother Su Chen?
Are you calling me brother?
He looked at Su Chen, and the SS-level pressure spread silently, and the air seemed to be stagnant.
Su Chen noticed the hostility of His Highness, and bowed slightly under the pressure: "Your Highness."
Then, he made a move that made Jiang Ting grit his teeth.
He gently took Jiang Zhixia's hand, intertwined their fingers, raised his head and smiled gently at Jiang Ting.
"Thanks to the princess's love, I also have admiration for the princess, and I hope that your highness will be satisfied with me."
Jiang Zhixia didn't struggle, she just held hands, and she had to perform a full performance.
Jiang Ting's eyes stayed on the hands held by the two of them for a few seconds.
Jiang Zhixia didn't dare to say anything, and Su Chen didn't know what His Highness meant.
"As you wish."
Jiang Ting dropped those two words and walked away with his long legs. His back was filled with the chill of keeping strangers away.
Monk Jiang Zhixia and Zhang Er were confused, "Brother...what's wrong?"
Seems angry?
News travels faster than the speed of light.
On that day, the news that "the third princess has chosen her real husband" became a hot search topic in the empire.
The official account of the royal family announced the candidates, and the picture was a solo image of Su Chen.
The comment section was filled with dissatisfaction:
【Su Chen? That therapist? The princess chooses him? ! 】
[If I remember correctly, he is an A-level deer, right? Ah, if I had known earlier, I would have signed up too! 】
[Don’t have such wishful thinking upstairs, I am a first-class noble after all. You wouldn’t even be qualified to run, just like Bai Zhiyu, hahaha]
[Wait a minute, don’t you think the princess might just like gentle people? It used to be Bai Zhiyu, now it’s Su Chen, they all seem to be of the same type]
[Wow...substitute literature? 】
Zeng Wenwen paced back and forth in the room, staring at Guang Nao in disbelief.
"Impossible...how is this possible?!"
Jiang Zhixia chose someone else to be her real husband?
Does she really dislike Bai Zhiyu? !
She watched the video of the birthday party, but because Jiang Zhixia's previous dog-licking behavior was so deeply rooted in people's hearts, she always thought it was a hard-to-get trick!
Jiang Zhixia said something to her about breaking up with her that day, and she was still angry.He stayed at home all day long, waiting for Jiang Zhixia to come and apologize.
Anyway, that fool has no friends around him, so he will definitely come to please her in a panic in a few days just like before.
But after waiting and waiting, everything changed!
Zeng Wenwen turned off her computer irritably and walked around the room twice more.
She had to go and see what was going on with Jiang Zhixia!
